What does Iguazu Falls really cost in 2026?

• Bus from the airport to the falls: under US$ 1
• Itaipu Dam tour: US$ 12
4 days from US$ 280 per person, budget style.
Heads-up: both Devil's Throat walkways are closed in late 2026. Check the park sites before you go.
